benefits: Up to 90% less water than traditional farming
Year-round climate independence and consistent quality
Reduced pesticide use via controlled environments

Potential coupling with solar energy and storage
challenges: Significant capital expenditure and O&M skills

Supply chain for substrates and nutrients

Aquaponics pilots integrating tilapia with greens
Container farms near universities and hospitals
